title: Implement A2A v1.0 agent card and task endpoint
description: Expose an A2A v1.0 compliant agent card at /.well-known/agent.json and implement the A2A tasks endpoint (POST /tasks or per spec: /tasks/send) accepting JSON-RPC task requests and returning valid task responses. Must not be implemented by the verification author.
acceptance_criteria: agent card served at /.well-known/agent.json with name, version, capabilities, endpoint URLs
tasks endpoint accepts A2A v1.0 JSON-RPC task requests and returns valid responses

verification.requirement: A separate developer (not the implementer) authors and runs a live probe against the deployed agent card and task endpoint; probe result recorded before closing ROADMAP-AGENT-A2A-V1.
